components.name: multi-target structural dependency/synergy decomposition
components.project_addition: For target row modules W_i under observation U, identifies two canonical module-valued rebates in joint defect accounting: target dependency relations R_W/R_U and observation-side join synergy S_U=(U cap sum W_i)/(sum U cap W_i). Gives a parenthesization-independent exact formula for joint defect mass and a two-target distributivity-defect specialization. Explicitly avoids Möbius inclusion-exclusion assumptions in the non-distributive subgroup lattice.
